newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Monday that around 1,800 head were exported into the United States at three crossing points Friday.
Through Santa Teresa, New Mexico, around 1,200 steer calves were sold, although not enough to establish quote prices.
"Around 90 percent of cattle crossed were previously contracted, retained by owners or sold on video, previously contracted or retained by owners," USDA said.
Through Nogales, Arizona, around 400 head were sold at steady prices compared to Thursday.
"Trade moderate, demand moderate. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb," the USDA said.
Prices for head weighing 300-400 lb were 91-101 cents/lb and for 400-500 lb head at 81-91 cents/lb.
Through Laredo, Texas around 200 head were sold, although not enough to establish market trend prices.
